summary: Verified public login screen and route protection for /colaboradores. All Supabase-dependent authenticated flows remain externally blocked per briefing (no NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL/ANON_KEY, no SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, migration_029 not applied, no test credentials). No mocked auth/data was used to approve any authenticated criterion.

checks.name: colaboradores-login-page-renders
checks.evidence: Navigated to /colaboradores/login (mobile viewport 390x844). Title, email/password fields and 'Entrar no workspace' button visible (data-testid=colaboradores-login-title/email/password/submit). Submitted with tscheck-login@example.com; since Supabase env vars are absent, form displayed data-testid=colaboradores-login-error with text matching 'A autenticação corporativa ainda não está configurada neste ambiente.' — explicit unavailability message, no fabricated auth. Screenshots captured.

checks.name: colaboradores-protected-routes-redirect
checks.evidence: Navigated to /colaboradores/vendedora, /colaboradores/sdr and /colaboradores/financeiro without a session; each request returned via server component redirect() to /colaboradores/login (confirmed page.url matches /\/colaboradores\/login/ and login page test-id visible) for all three roles. Source confirmed in src/app/colaboradores/[cargo]/page.tsx: redirect('/colaboradores/login') when sessao.user is null.
